Beginner glossary

Plain-language definitions used throughout this manual.

On this page
Core terms

Core terms

TermMeaning
ActorObject that can exist in a world, such as an enemy, gate or resource node.
Pawn / CharacterControllable Actor; Character includes standard capsule/movement support.
PlayerControllerConnection/input routing object; local client handles UI, server validates owned requests.
PlayerStateReplicated in-zone player facts. Not a persistent database.
GameMode / GameStateServer world rules versus shared replicated world state.
GameInstanceOne per process; survives local map changes but does not synchronize processes.
Dedicated serverGame simulation process without a local player; requires separate identity/storage/hosting systems.
AuthorityThe component/service allowed to decide and mutate a fact.
ReplicationSending selected approved state to relevant clients.
RPCNetwork function request subject to Unreal ownership/execution rules.
Prediction / reconciliationClient anticipates responsive behavior; server corrections restore approved state.
Data Asset / Data TableAuthored immutable definition object or typed row catalog, not player inventory.
Soft referenceAsset reference by resolvable path/identity that can load later; validate presence and lifetime.
NavMeshNavigation representation of walkable surfaces used by AI pathfinding.
World Partition / streamingLoading pieces of one world; not transferring a character between server processes.
Paper2D / Flipbook2D sprite assets and frame-based playback inside Unreal.
PaperZDThird-party animation graph tooling; installed compatibility/API must be verified.
UMGUnreal UI widgets and layout system; presentation, not rule authority.
GAS / ASC / Attribute SetGameplay Ability System, its owning Ability System Component and replicated attribute data.
Gameplay TagStructured named gameplay classification, such as State.Dead or Tool.Pickaxe.
TransactionAll-or-nothing durable set of related record changes.
IdempotencyRetrying the same command produces the same durable effect/result rather than another reward.
Command receiptStored result bound to command ID and request hash.
Session epoch / fencingMonotonic ownership version that makes old server writes invalid.
Schema migrationVersioned transformation of database structure/records with tested recovery.
Projection / cacheLocal copy/view of authoritative state; not a second independent truth.
Definition ID / instance IDTemplate identity versus one particular owned nonstackable item.
FixtureControlled test map, profiles and data designed to reproduce expected behavior.
Relevancy / dormancyWhich clients need an Actor and whether unchanged state can stop frequent replication.
PlaceholderExplicit temporary art/content/test substitute, not proof of a finished asset.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
